comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the pedestrian initiator; the pedestrian remains within the trafficway, stationary or moving parallel without crossing. Chosen assumptions: The pedestrian initiates the conflict by walking slowly forward within the trafficway, near the right side of ego lane. Ego responds by changing into a clear same-direction left lane. The schema crossing value denotes walking parallel to the roadway, without lateral crossing. Distances are meters, speeds meters per second, reaction delay seconds, and brake/throttle controls dimensionless. The pedestrian conflict begins at time zero. These realizations create conflict opportunities; no collision outcome is imposed.
